groups.title: Offshore Services
groups.summary: Highest standards in quality and safety for your offshore installation, rig or drill ship, in Houston and world wide.
groups.intro: With our expertise gained by working with marine vessels and industrial projects, our experienced personnel and engineers have a vast knowledge in application of marine classification society codes such as ABS, DNV and other IACS Members, as well as industrial codes such as ASME and API. Our project experience includes new process piping, structural reinforcements, pumping skid fabrications, hull repairs, specialized conversions, mechanical maintenance, machining services and customized rig modifications. In addition to our engineering services we offer inspection services, certification services, marine surveyor and cleaning and painting services for your rigs or drill ships. Knowing the hazards of working offshore, our team is well trained with the highest quality and safety standards in mind.

groups.title: Marine Services
groups.summary: Marine services around the clock for vessels calling in U.S. ports, from repairs to supplies and crew transportation.
groups.intro: We understand that your vessels may require both occasional and regular service when calling in U.S. ports. For over 30 years, Alpha Mar's repair division has responded to the needs of the maritime and offshore industries by providing ship owners and managers 24/7, high quality and economical services while ensuring the vessel's optimal performance. Designed to work as a one stop solution, we can assist with any ship services you may need, from repairs, to supplies and crew transportation, to ship general maintenance. We specialize in engine and auxiliary equipment repairs, hatch covers, cranes, steel repairs, parts manufacturing and much more.

groups.title: Industrial Services
groups.summary: Turnkey engineering, construction, maintenance and support services for the shore based industry around Houston.
groups.intro: The Alpha Mar Group is your one source for engineering, industrial, construction, maintenance and support services. We specialize in turnkey solutions and comprehensive services for companies in the shore based industry around Houston, with long term contracts for on-site as well as shop fabrication and production. We have completed jobs like pipeline installations, structural fabrications, skid fabrications, tank services and hundreds of machined parts for our clients in the energy industry. Let us know what you need and our dedicated engineering department will take care of your projects.

about.title: Established in the 1980s for petrochemical and maritime work
text: Alpha Mar was established in the 1980s to cater to the petrochemical and maritime industry. Some of the areas in which we excel are ship repair, modification, engineering and other technical marine systems and controls, which were later incorporated in the offshore industry as well.

It has been the primary goal of Alpha Mar to consistently provide our customers with exceptional service and maximum value, while exceeding our customers' expectations and maintaining our strong leadership role among our peers.
Our mission is to continually maintain and improve our status as one of the most reliable organizations in the marine repair, maintenance and fabrication industries in the world.

facts.heading: Our Location
facts.text: Our administrative offices and primary machining operations are within minutes of Hobby Airport and the Houston Ship Channel, with fast access to the 610 Loop and the Gulf Freeway. The facility is in the heart of an established industrial area, with rail access close to the complex along Mykawa Road.

facts.heading: Where We Work
facts.text: Houston and world wide. We serve the entire Gulf Coast, from the Port of Houston, City Docks, Barbours Cut and Jacintoport to Galveston, Bolivar Roads and Corpus Christi, and our engineers have travelled to jobs in Miami and Kingston, Jamaica.
